reasoning: This question asks about comparing daily average temperatures at Lille Airport on two dates in late October and early November 2025. November 2 is 7 days after October 26. In the Northern Hemisphere, late October to early November shows a seasonal cooling trend as winter approaches. Typically, temperatures decline by roughly 1-2°C per week during this transition period. The probability that a date one week later would be warmer is therefore below 50%, though not negligible due to weather variability and occasional warm spells.
